name: JJCT LLC

nadir.desc: The property consists of the main residence, adjacent detached and attached structures, multiple agricultural buildings, including metal-roof structures and greenhouse-style buildings, plus two large ponds and cultivated fields|A gravel drive and paved access connect the buildings to the public road|Rows of crops occupy sections of the parcel|Mature trees and open grass areas sit between the structures and the road|Neighboring agricultural land surrounds the site.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from Coleman Creek Rd via a paved drive that connects to gravel circulation areas around the buildings. The site is an agricultural property with perhaps two residences, multiple metal-roof and greenhouse structures, a large pond, and cultivated fields. Open ground and gravel areas provide circulation space around the buildings. No gates are visible from the imagery. Neighboring agricultural land surrounds the parcel.
